title: PvPFlow
description: PvPFlow is a clean, high-contrast Minecraft PvP resource pack designed for competitive gameplay.
body:
🔥 PvPFlow — Resource Pack

PvPFlow is a lightweight, competitive-focused resource pack designed to give you a cleaner visual experience and better clarity during PvP fights.

✨ Key Features
🎯 Optimized PvP Visuals
Every texture is redesigned to reduce visual clutter and improve combat readability.

🏹 Clean Weapon Design
Bow and combat items are reworked for better visibility during fast-paced fights.

🌌 Custom Skybox
A unique sky that enhances immersion without distracting from gameplay.

🔥 Optimized Fire
Fire effects are less obstructive, giving you a clearer view in fights.

🧱 Block Clarity Improvements
Wool and clay textures are redesigned for better contrast and readability in PvP arenas.

💫 Enhanced Enchant Glint
A modernized enchantment effect that looks cleaner while staying visible in combat.

🛡️ Armor Improvements
Leather armor has been cleaned up by removing unnecessary overlay effects for a more consistent visual style.

⚠️ Notes
Some textures (like wool) are still experimental and may be adjusted based on community feedback.

PvPFlow is constantly evolving — expect regular updates focused on performance, clarity, and competitive balance.
